reviews.review: You can play different role in this game like the classic foot soldier (Ranger), heavy exo suit warrior (Fencer), agile jetpack female soldier (Wing Diver) and support focused class (Air rider). There are multiple difficulty to select so casual and tryhard players can enjoy the game! In coop mode armor and weapon level setting can be adjusted to lowest level player in the room, so everyone can enjoy the game in balanced way, nobody feel underpowered. Some weapons are unique and tricky to use, it's fun to try them all. But farming on max health improvement and better weapons might be repetitive and tedious for player that want to clear harder difficulty, especially Inferno. The weapons dropped are random, so it's luck based if you can get what you actually want. But still you get all classes weapon despite what class you was playing on that grind. Overall highly recommended!

Fun and chaotic horde shooter. The gameplay loop is simple and fun, you shoot bugs and get new weapons and vehicles. The dialogue is funny and the EDF is the most motivated fictional military.
If you plan to play this on a gaming laptop make sure to look up how to improve the performance, because it's not supposed to run in slow-motion.

EDF 5 is pure, unfiltered fun. Hundreds of missions, tons of weapons, and more alien insects than your screen can handle—all wrapped in the most charmingly B-movie energy imaginable. It’s janky, loud, and completely over-the-top… and that’s exactly what makes it great.
